rationale: Embedding execution has one bounded ranking point only after FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001 has formed an admitted typed candidate set and Inference Portability plus HRB have established executable backend/resource eligibility. Decision Fabric may rank only those already-eligible candidates using non-secret quality, locality, latency, batching, resource-pressure or migration-comparison evidence. It may not create providers, infer capabilities from model names, admit models/providers, change EmbeddingSpaceIdentity, authorize cross-space direct similarity, bypass HRB, or perform migration cutover. Browser Semantic Find and the TEI/Model2Vec/FlagEmbedding projections reuse the same bounded ranking semantics and do not create independent decision authorities.

decision_points.purpose: rank already admitted typed embedding/rerank execution candidates without expanding the candidate set

project_radar_review.scope: Embedding Fabric, Browser Semantic Find, TEI, Model2Vec and FlagEmbedding against current Model Router, Inference Portability, HRB, Knowledge/Retrieval, Security and Evidence boundaries
project_radar_review.note: The candidate set stays deterministic and authority-owned; migration and semantic-compatibility gates remain fail-closed.
